words.tr: 你可以（表示能力或许可）
words.ex: You can solve the equation using algebra.
words.ex_cn: 你可以用代数来解这个方程。
words.en: Used to express ability, permission, or possibility.

words.tr: contraction你将(=you will)
words.ex: You'll pass the test if you study hard.
words.ex_cn: 如果你努力学习，你会通过考试的。
words.en: You'll is the usual spoken form of 'you will'.

words.tr: 我们将震撼你（皇后乐队知名曲目）
words.ex: We will rock you with our music!
words.ex_cn: 我们将用我们的音乐震撼你！
words.en: We will is used to indicate a future action or state that is intended, expected, or promised to occur.

words.tr: 短语. 有（用于单数或不可数名词前）
words.ex: There is a book on the table.
words.ex_cn: 桌子上有一本书。
words.en: used to say that something exists or happens

words.tr: 也将会有；此外还会存在
words.ex: There will also be more apples tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天也会有更多的苹果。
words.en: Used to indicate that something additional will happen or exist.

words.tr: phrase. 我建议；我提议
words.ex: I suggest we go to the park.
words.ex_cn: 我建议我们去公园。
words.en: Used to make a recommendation or offer advice.

words.tr: 我们将要（用于表示将来计划或意图）
words.ex: We're going to the park after school.
words.ex_cn: 我们放学后要去公园。
words.en: Used to express a plan or intention for the near future.

words.tr: conj. 如果...请（用于礼貌请求的条件句中，非标准固定短语，通常为口语中分句连接）
words.ex: If you can, please help me carry this box.
words.ex_cn: 如果你能的话，请帮我搬这个箱子。
words.en: A conditional phrase used to politely make a request or suggestion.

words.tr: 我们确实拥有（用于强调某物的存在或真实性）
words.ex: We do have time to finish the project.
words.ex_cn: 我们确实有时间完成这个项目。
words.en: Used to confirm the existence or possession of something.

words.w: what we want to do is
words.tr: 我们想要做的是
words.uk: wɒt wiː wɒnt tə duː ɪz
words.us: wɑːt wiː wɑːnt tə duː ɪz
words.ex: What we want to do is finish the homework.
words.ex_cn: 我们想做的是完成作业。
words.en: Used to introduce the main action or intention of the speaker.

words.tr: 短语. 有一件事……不过（用于引出转折或补充说明）
words.ex: I don't like the movie one thing though, the music is great.
words.ex_cn: 我不喜欢这部电影，有一件事不过，音乐很棒。
words.en: A transitional phrase used to introduce a contrasting point or exception.

words.tr: phrase. 直到……才……（用于强调某事发生得比预期晚）
words.ex: It wasn't until he saw the results that he believed it.
words.ex_cn: 直到他看到结果，他才相信。
words.en: Used to emphasize that something did not happen before a particular point in time.

words.tr: phrase. 尤其；特别
words.ex: I like fruits, in particular apples.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢水果，尤其是苹果。
words.en: Especially; more than other things or people.

words.tr: adv. 尤其；专门；
words.ex: I like all fruits, especially apples.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢所有的水果，尤其是苹果。
words.en: You use especially to emphasize that what you are saying applies more to one thing or situation than to others.

words.w: it's no good if we don't
words.tr: phrase. 如果我们不这样做就没用；我们不这样做的话是不行的
words.uk: ɪtz nəʊ gʊd ɪf wi dəʊnt
words.us: ɪts noʊ gud ɪf wi don't
words.ex: It's no good if we don't try.
words.ex_cn: 如果我们不尝试，那就没用。
words.en: Used to express that something is ineffective or pointless without a particular condition or action.

words.w: it's here that demand is greatest
words.tr: phrase. 正是在这里需求最大
words.uk: ɪts hɪə ðət dɪˈmɑːnd ɪz ˈɡreɪtɪst
words.us: ɪts hɪr ðæt dɪˈmænd ɪz ˈɡreɪtɪst
words.ex: It's here that demand is greatest.
words.ex_cn: 正是在这里，需求最大。
words.en: A phrase indicating that the highest level of demand occurs at this specific location or time.

words.tr: phrase. 事实上；实际上
words.ex: He says he likes sports, but in fact, he hates them.
words.ex_cn: 他说他喜欢运动，但事实上，他讨厌它们。
words.en: You use in fact to emphasize that something is true, especially when it contradicts what has just been said or might be expected.

words.tr: prep. 不像于；不同于；
words.ex: Unlike his brother, he likes quiet places.
words.ex_cn: 不像他的兄弟，他喜欢安静的地方。
words.en: If one thing is unlike another thing, the two things are different in nature or in appearance.

words.tr: phrase. 代替做某事；而不是做某事
words.ex: Instead of doing homework, he went out to play.
words.ex_cn: 他没有做作业，而是出去玩。
words.en: In place of performing an action.

words.tr: 我们正在做（某事）
words.ex: We're doing homework now.
words.ex_cn: 我们正在做作业。
words.en: A phrase used to describe an action currently in progress.

words.tr: 而不是……他们会（表示偏好或选择，常用于对比两种行为或状态）
words.ex: He'd walk to work rather than they'd drive.
words.ex_cn: 他宁愿走路去上班，而不是他们会开车。
words.en: Used to express a preference for one option over another, often implying a hypothetical alternative.

words.tr: 并非直接用于...而是用于
words.ex: He didn't use the tool not as such to fix the chair but to open the box.
words.ex_cn: 他使用这个工具并非直接用于修理椅子，而是用于打开盒子。
words.en: A structure indicating that something is not true in one specific way, but is true in another, different way.

words.tr: 我们本以为我……但是
words.ex: We'd expected i...but
words.ex_cn: 我们本以为我……但
words.en: Used to express that a previous expectation was not met, introducing an unexpected outcome.

words.tr: phrase. & adv. 但是不幸的是
words.ex: I wanted to go, but unfortunately it rained.
words.ex_cn: 我想去，但不幸的是下雨了。
words.en: Regrettably.

words.tr: adv. 伤心地；难过地；
words.ex: He sadly said goodbye to his dog.
words.ex_cn: 他伤心地跟他的狗说了再见。
words.en: In a manner that expresses sorrow or unhappiness.

words.tr: adv. 然而；不过；不论到什么程度；无论如何；
words.ex: I like coffee; however, I drink tea in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢咖啡；然而，我早上喝茶。
words.en: You use however when you are adding a comment which is surprising or which contrasts with what has just been said.

words.tr: phrase. 尽管
words.ex: He went out even though it was raining.
words.ex_cn: 尽管在下雨，他还是出去了。
words.en: You use even though to introduce a clause which gives the reason for something, but which makes the reason seem less important or significant.

words.tr: conj. 虽然；尽管；
words.ex: Although it was raining, he went outside.
words.ex_cn: 虽然天下雨了，他还是出去了。
words.en: Despite the fact that; even though.

words.tr: phrase. 几乎所有人
words.ex: Almost all the people like ice cream.
words.ex_cn: 几乎所有人都喜欢冰淇淋。
words.en: Nearly every person in a group or population.

words.tr: phrase. 几乎每个人；差不多所有人
words.ex: Nearly everyone likes ice cream.
words.ex_cn: 几乎每个人都喜欢冰淇淋。
words.en: An expression meaning almost every person in a group or society.

words.tr: 那里有一些人（用于陈述存在某些人）
words.ex: There are some people who like algebra.
words.ex_cn: 有一些人喜欢代数。
words.en: A number of individuals exist within a group.

words.tr: 短语. 大量的人；相当多的人
words.ex: A significant number of people like to walk in the park.
words.ex_cn: 相当多的人喜欢在公园里散步。
words.en: A large or considerable number of individuals.

words.tr: phrase. 在每个房间里；遍及每个房间
words.ex: There is a chair in every room.
words.ex_cn: 每个房间里都有一把椅子。
words.en: Located or occurring within each individual room.

words.tr: 短语. 有一件事……不过（用于引出转折或补充说明）
words.ex: I don't like the movie one thing though, the music is great.
words.ex_cn: 我不喜欢这部电影，有一件事不过，音乐很棒。
words.en: A transitional phrase used to introduce a contrasting point or exception.

words.tr: phrase. + pron. + verb. 但是你必须
words.ex: But you have to finish your homework.
words.ex_cn: 但你必须完成你的作业。
words.en: A phrase indicating that a specific action or condition is necessary or unavoidable.

words.w: that's an experience not to be missed
words.tr: 那是一次不容错过的经历
words.uk: ðæts ən ɪkˈspɪriəns nɒt tu bi mɪst
words.us: ðæts ən ɪkˈspɪriəns noʊt tu bi mɪst
words.ex: That's an experience not to be missed.
words.ex_cn: 那是一次不容错过的经历。
words.en: An idiomatic expression meaning an event or situation that is highly recommended because it provides a unique or valuable experience.

words.tr: 你应当……无论……还是……（用于表达建议或义务，后接两种选择）
words.ex: You should eat vegetables whether you like them or not.
words.ex_cn: 无论你喜不喜欢，你都应该吃蔬菜。
words.en: Used to present two alternatives, emphasizing that the advice applies regardless of which one is true.

words.tr: 我们也在考虑
words.ex: We're also thinking of buying a new car.
words.ex_cn: 我们也在考虑买一辆新车。
words.en: We are also considering.

words.tr: phrase. 考虑；思考；琢磨（某事）
words.ex: He is thinking about his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他正在考虑他的作业。
words.en: Considering or contemplating something.

words.tr: v. 考虑；“consider”的现在分词； prep. 考虑到；就…而言；鉴于；
words.ex: I am considering going to the park.
words.ex_cn: 我正在考虑去公园。
words.en: Taking into account; in view of.

words.tr: n. 计划；规划； v. 计划；打算；“plan”的现在分词；
words.ex: The planning for the trip took a week.
words.ex_cn: 这次旅行的计划花了一周时间。
words.en: The process of making plans for something.

words.tr: phrase. 在某个阶段；在某一时刻
words.ex: At some stage, we'll need to stop and think.
words.ex_cn: 在某个阶段，我们需要停下来思考。
words.en: Used to indicate that something will happen at some unspecified time in the future.

words.tr: phrase. 打算
words.ex: I intend to go to the park tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我打算明天去公园。
words.en: If you intend to do something, you have decided or planned to do it.

words.tr: phrase. 计划做；打算做；有意做
words.ex: I plan to go to the park tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我计划明天去公园。
words.en: To intend or have the intention of doing something.

words.tr: 我们将要（用于表示将来计划或意图）
words.ex: We're going to the park after school.
words.ex_cn: 我们放学后要去公园。
words.en: Used to express a plan or intention for the near future.

words.tr: 我们即将要做（某事）
words.ex: We're about to do algebra homework.
words.ex_cn: 我们即将做代数作业。
words.en: We are going to do something very soon.

words.tr: phrase. 不久的将来
words.ex: I will buy a new phone in the near future.
words.ex_cn: 我将在不久的将来买一部新手机。
words.en: At a time that is not far away from now.

words.tr: 我们很乐意（做某事）
words.ex: We'd love to join you for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我们很乐意和你一起吃晚饭。
words.en: An expression of strong desire or willingness to do something.

words.tr: 一个更晚的计划是
words.ex: A later plan is to visit the museum after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 一个更晚的计划是午饭后去参观博物馆。
words.en: A plan that is scheduled or intended to occur at a later time.

words.tr: phrase. 一直意味着；始终表示
words.ex: This word has always meant kindness to her.
words.ex_cn: 这个词对她来说一直意味着善意。
words.en: Has consistently signified or been understood as.

words.tr: 我们已经（用于表示某事已完成或发生）
words.ex: We've already finished our homework.
words.ex_cn: 我们已经完成了作业。
words.en: We have already done or experienced something.

words.tr: 我们已经设法做到（某事）
words.ex: We've managed to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: phrase. 我们已经设法按时完成了项目。
words.en: We have succeeded in doing something.

words.tr: phrase. 我们已做预算（we had budgeted 的缩写形式，表示过去完成时）
words.ex: We'd budgeted $50 for the trip.
words.ex_cn: 我们原本为这次旅行预算了50美元。
words.en: We had allocated funds for something.

words.tr: phrase. 曾经；同时；一度
words.ex: At one time, he played soccer every day.
words.ex_cn: 曾经，他每天踢足球。
words.en: If something was the case at one time, it was the case during a particular period in the past.

words.tr: phrase. 在某一阶段；曾经
words.ex: At one stage, he wanted to be a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 有一段时间，他想当老师。
words.en: At a particular point or period in a process or series of events.

words.tr: phrase. 在十九世纪
words.ex: Many new inventions appeared in the nineteenth century.
words.ex_cn: 许多新发明出现在十九世纪。
words.en: During the 1800s.

words.w: but when we started it was only
words.tr: 但当我们开始时，只有
words.uk: bʌt wen wi ˈstɑːtɪd ɪt wɒz ˈəʊnli
words.us: bʌt wen wi ˈstɑːrtɪd ɪt wʌz ˈoʊnli
words.ex: But when we started it was only two people.
words.ex_cn: 但当我们开始时，只有两个人。
words.en: At the beginning of an action, it was limited to a small scale or basic level.

words.w: but he died before it was completed
words.tr: phrase. 但是；然而；不过
words.uk: bʌt hi daid bɪfɔː r ɪt wəz kəmˈpliːtɪd
words.us: bʌt hi dɛd bɪˈfɔr ɪt wəz kəmˈpliːtɪd
words.ex: He wanted to finish the book, but he died before it was completed.
words.ex_cn: 他想完成这本书，但他还没完成就去世了。
words.en: However, he passed away prior to its completion.

words.tr: phrase. 首先；起先
words.ex: At first, he did not like math.
words.ex_cn: 起初，他不喜欢数学。
words.en: At the beginning; initially.

words.tr: phrase. 当时；此刻；现在
words.ex: He was busy at the moment.
words.ex_cn: 当时他很忙。
words.en: At the moment is used to indicate that something is happening now.

words.tr: phrase. & adv. 但是现在；然而目前
words.ex: He liked math, but now he hates it.
words.ex_cn: 他以前喜欢数学，但现在讨厌了。
words.en: However, at this moment or in contrast to a previous situation.

words.tr: adv. 现在；现今；目前；
words.ex: Nowadays, many children use tablets to learn.
words.ex_cn: 现在，许多孩子用平板电脑学习。
words.en: At the present time, in contrast with the past.

words.tr: phrase. 现在；目前
words.ex: At present, he is working as a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 目前，他是一名老师。
words.en: At the present time; now.

words.w: that's an area we're still working on now
words.tr: 这是一个我们目前正在努力的领域
words.uk: ðæts ən ˈeəriə wiər stɪl ˈwɜːkɪŋ ɒn naʊ
words.us: ðæts ən ˈɛriə wɪr stɪl ˈwɜːrkɪŋ ɑːn naʊ
words.ex: That's an area we're still working on now.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个我们目前正在努力的领域。
words.en: An area of development that is still being improved or addressed currently.

words.tr: phrase. 目前
words.ex: At the present time, he is working at a small company.
words.ex_cn: 目前，他正在一家小公司工作。
words.en: At this moment; currently.

words.tr: phrase. 去年；上一年
words.ex: He visited Paris last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年去了巴黎。
words.en: The year before the current one.

words.tr: phrase. 在将来；日后
words.ex: I will go to college in the future.
words.ex_cn: 我将来会去上大学。
words.en: at a time after the present

words.tr: phrase. 在过去
words.ex: He played soccer in the past.
words.ex_cn: 他过去踢足球。
words.en: At a time before the present; in earlier times.

words.tr: phrase. 长期计划是无中文释义
words.ex: The company made a long term plan is to expand overseas.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司制定了一个长期计划，即拓展海外市场。
words.en: The long-term strategy is.

words.tr: adv. 最近；近来；
words.ex: I recently bought a new book.
words.ex_cn: 我最近买了一本新书。
words.en: If something happened recently, it happened only a short time ago.

words.tr: phrase. 在前五年里；在最初的五年中
words.ex: He worked hard in the first five years.
words.ex_cn: 他在头五年努力工作。
words.en: During the initial five-year period.

words.tr: n.计划
words.ex: He made new plans for the weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他为周末制定了新的计划。
words.en: A plan is a method of achieving something that you have worked out in detail beforehand.

words.tr: v. 修正；温习；校订；
words.ex: He revised his answer to make it correct.
words.ex_cn: 他修正了他的答案，使其正确。
words.en: To revise something means to alter or amend it, especially in order to correct or improve it.

words.tr: phrase. + v. 终于开始行动；终于启动起来
words.ex: We finally get going after waiting for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 我们等了公交车后终于出发了。
words.en: To start or begin something after a delay or preparation.

words.tr: v. 完成；结束；
words.ex: He will finish his homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他会在晚饭前完成作业。
words.en: To finish something means to reach the end of it or to complete it.

words.tr: phrase. 一开始有了这个想法
words.ex: I first had the idea to start a garden last spring.
words.ex_cn: 我一开始有了这个想法，是在去年春天开始种花园。
words.en: A phrase used to introduce the moment when a person first conceived a thought or plan.

words.tr: phrase. 已经持续运行了
words.ex: It has been running for three hours.
words.ex_cn: 它已经持续运行了三个小时。
words.en: Something has been in operation or continuing for a period of time.

words.tr: 我们很乐意（做某事）
words.ex: We'd love to join you for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我们很乐意和你一起吃晚饭。
words.en: An expression of strong desire or willingness to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 但当我们开始时
words.ex: We were tired, but when we started, we felt energized.
words.ex_cn: 我们很累，但当我们开始时，感觉充满活力。
words.en: A phrase used to introduce a contrast or exception to a previous statement, often referring to a past event.
